_comment: PLACEHOLDER RUNS. Every number in `runs` is invented so the UI can be built before training finishes. ml/export_results.py overwrites this whole file with the real runs and isMock false; never type real numbers in by hand. The `dataset` block is copied from the export's dataset card and split manifest. While isMock is true the app shows a 'Demo data' badge everywhere these numbers appear.
protocol: Same frozen split (potholes_yolo_v1), seed 42 and 40 epochs for every run; one change per run against E0. The test split is read once per run, after training.
championRule: Highest validation mAP50; within 0.01, higher validation recall at confidence 0.40.

runs.name: yolo26s
runs.changed: Model width: yolo26s.pt instead of nano

runs.name: no-pretraining
runs.changed: No transfer learning: yolo26n.yaml, random weights

runs.name: p2-head
runs.changed: Architecture: extra P2 detection scale for small objects (yolo26n-p2.yaml)

runs.name: best-combination
runs.changed: Best combination of E1–E7, chosen with the selection rule

dataset.name: Annotated Potholes Image Dataset (version potholes_yolo_v1)
dataset.licence: ODbL (database) and DbCL (contents), as shown on Kaggle, read 11 Nov 2026
dataset.split: Random by image, seed 42, after a duplicate check
dataset.notes: Rebuilt from Kaggle and checked against the split manifest by data/make_potholes_yolo_v1.py; images are not in git.
